evidence: Independent manual source audit of all 88 criterion descriptions (1 Render, 1 Constraints, 74 Functional, 6 Polish and 6 Visual) and their complete prompts/app context found no instance of enumerating one full-credit requirement and then waiving that requirement. All file paths below are under .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/. The workbook Quality Checks row 34 defines this check; its internal E34 note permits shared flows, while qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires independently useful outcomes to retain independent credit. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:9 says binary rows own separate outcomes and prohibits an all-legs score for a whole protocol; :100 requires meaningful positive controls and actual observations, and :113 says every required observation must still be made. Functional descriptions and corresponding scenarios agree: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:77 requires a working pre-Stop handler, stopped feedback and suppression; :84 separately requires the actual successful visible picture to remain. The clarification at prompt.md:159-161 permits a static retained picture, but never treats deletion as preservation. The network-preview conditional at functional/judge.toml:126 and prompt.md:207 has one conditional bar: an explicit execution refusal restores last-good, whereas a caught blocked operation may complete its legitimate authored code. Both attempts still require actual blocked/refusal evidence, so the branch is an observable semantic distinction, not a waiver. Likewise, functional/judge.toml:308 and :315 require a working automatic execution plus off-state suppression and deliberate execution of the exact pending source; their statement that debounce-reset success is not a prerequisite excludes a separately owned outcome without relaxing those requirements. The restart write fallback at :378 and prompt.md:429-432 still requires a successful post-restart current-revision update and fresh read, while durability remains independently graded. Gate bars remain explicit at tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 and tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-29. Polish defines permitted layout/native-control alternatives without dropping its named observations (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23, :41, :50, :59, :68). Each Visual criterion has one raw-5 anchor (tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:25, :40, :55, :70, :85, :100), and visual/prompt.md:48-53 consistently specifies coherent presentation rather than aesthetic perfection. Adversarial reasoning, not an executed model trial: a broken app that removes the whole preview on Stop could earn suppression after its working handler control but cannot earn completed_stop_preview; a dead Auto-run cannot exploit the debounce independence language to earn either off-state row. A conforming app that retains a static successful picture after Stop, proactively prevents a stale save with feedback and exact draft retention, or uses native menus remains eligible under functional/judge.toml:84, :392 and polish/judge.toml:41/:59. No competing full-credit interpretation was found for these alternatives. All 84 frozen task/rules files matched the manifest hashes and assigned input SHA256. The current raw-evidence index was bound to the same input and all 519 indexed artifact hashes matched when read; it was not used as proof of runtime behavior. This wording-focused row requires no runtime measurement, and this Pass makes no Oracle, target-model, full-judge-duration or portal claim.
